::: {.page-intro}
I teach simulation and combinatorial optimisation at the Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC), Department of Statistics and Operations Research. My lab assignments use the same tools I build on [OR Labs](https://orlabs.cloud), which students can access with their university email.
:::

## Courses

::: {.entry}
[2023–present]{.when}

::: {}
**Discrete Network Models** · MSc in Statistics and Operations Research

Network optimisation, routing and combinatorial problems, with exact methods and metaheuristics.
:::
:::

::: {.entry}
[2024–present]{.when}

::: {}
**Simulation** · BSc in Informatics Engineering

Discrete-event simulation, design of experiments and system dynamics, with hands-on lab assignments.
